explainability_boundary.purpose: Explain why Trailaris entered or managed a trade without exposing enough detail to reconstruct the exact strategy.
allowed_examples: Risk and portfolio conditions permitted execution
prohibited_explanation_detail: Internal candidate ranking values where disclosure would aid reverse engineering
explainability_boundary.timing_rule: Customer-facing rationale becomes available after the associated execution instruction has been accepted/executed, not as a pre-trade signal broadcast.

license_account_binding.additional_account_rule: Every additional live trading account requires an additional paid account entitlement/license fee.
license_account_binding.account_change: Requires controlled re-binding/deactivation of the prior account under Trailaris administration; it is not a user-editable engine setting.

anti_signal_resale.objective: Prevent Trailaris from becoming an easily extractable or redistributable live signal feed and make unauthorized signal commercialization difficult, detectable and enforceable.
controls: No pre-trade BUY/SELL signal broadcast to customer surfaces
Execution occurs through the account-bound Trailaris executor before customer-facing rationale is revealed
No customer API, webhook or machine-readable live-signal export
No exportable strategy parameters or signal thresholds
Live execution instructions are cryptographically signed and bound to license, device, broker account, campaign and validity window
Captured instructions cannot be replayed on another licensed or unlicensed account
Result-sharing outputs are canonical Trailaris-verified result objects rather than live signal objects
Open-trade/customer views may be individually watermarked/traceable where appropriate
Central telemetry monitors abnormal activation, scraping, automation and redistribution patterns
Administrative suspension/revocation is available for material license abuse
Commercial terms explicitly prohibit unauthorized redistribution/resale of Trailaris execution signals or systematic copying services
anti_signal_resale.truth_boundary: A customer who can see trades in their own brokerage account can manually tell another person what they see; architecture cannot make human observation impossible. The system must instead prevent scalable extraction, pre-trade broadcasting, automated redistribution, replay and unauthorized multi-account execution while making abuse traceable and commercially enforceable.

customer_installs: Trailaris MT5 Executor/Dashboard Expert Advisor (compiled EX5)
expert_advisor_role: Occupy/render the Trailaris full-chart MT5 interface
Read authorized local MT5 account/execution state
Receive only account-bound signed execution/management envelopes
Render high-level trade rationale and trade dossiers
Transmit execution telemetry and system health
secure_connector_role: Authenticate the installation to Trailaris-controlled infrastructure
Relay signed execution envelopes and telemetry
Support update/integrity checks and central alerting
mt5_distribution.position_guardian: If central connectivity is lost, no new entries are permitted. Existing positions may be managed only within a previously signed contingency safety envelope; this component does not contain trade-discovery or strategy-selection intelligence.
deployment_flow: Valid purchase and one-account entitlement created
Installer deploys signed MT5 Executor/Dashboard and Secure Connector
Customer activates against the licensed Trailaris identity
Exact approved broker and MT5 trading account are bound
Executor is attached to a dedicated MT5 chart and takes over that chart canvas with the Trailaris full-screen dashboard
Connector establishes authenticated session to Trailaris-controlled infrastructure
Server-side Market Execution Engine sends only signed account-specific execution/management envelopes
MT5 executor validates and executes them
Health, alerts, fills and results return to the Trailaris control plane

security_principle: Anything sufficiently sensitive that disclosure would compromise Trailaris must never be delivered to the customer-controlled machine.
